scenes.headline: How GPTQ quantizes a layer, and what got faster
scenes.sub: LLM Compressor 0.14 moved the slow loop into one Triton kernel.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Chickpea! GPTQ squeezes weights to four bits, one layer at a time. Here's how, and what just got fifteen times faster.

scenes.text: Round one column at a time, and push its rounding error onto the columns not yet rounded, so the layer's output barely moves.
scenes.mark: push its rounding error onto the columns not yet rounded
scenes.say: Round one column at a time, and push each rounding error onto the columns still waiting, so the layer's output barely moves.

steps.say: Run calibration samples through the model, and gather each layer's inputs into one matrix, H.
Dampen it by one percent, and factor its inverse once, with a Cholesky decomposition.
Round column j to the grid. Its error, scaled by the factor's diagonal, has to be made up.
One row of the factor spreads that error over the columns to the right. Correlated inputs absorb the most.
The paper works in blocks of a hundred and twenty-eight columns, updating only inside the block.
Then one matrix multiply updates everything to the right. Same arithmetic, far fewer passes over memory.

left.title: Eager PyTorch loop
items: A string of tiny kernels per column
Same cost on dense and MoE
left.say: The old loop launched a string of tiny kernels for every column: about two hundred fourteen microseconds each, dense or MoE.

right.title: One fused Triton kernel
items: Rows in parallel, columns in order
Same-shaped experts stacked into one solve
right.say: Version zero point fourteen walks a whole block inside one Triton kernel, and stacks same-shaped experts into one solve.

scenes.title: GPTQ end to end, Llama 3 8B
scenes.note: one H100; 8 samples of 256 random tokens
scenes.say: On Llama 3 8B the run fell from two hundred sixty-six seconds to under eighteen. But that was on about two thousand calibration tokens.

scenes.text: GPTQ's arithmetic was never the slow part. Launch overhead on every column was.
scenes.say: GPTQ's arithmetic was never the slow part. Launch overhead on every column was.

recap: Round a column, spread its error right
One Triton kernel walks each block
Measured on a tiny calibration set
scenes.say: To recap: round a column, spread its error right, and do the whole block in one kernel.
